# Iconoir 7.12.1

100 selected regular SVGs from https://github.com/iconoir-icons/iconoir/tree/v7.12.1,
Copyright (c) 2021 Luca Burgio, under the MIT licence in LICENSE.

These sources generate the engine's identifiable development fallback vectors:
`bun scripts/fallback-icons.ts`. The game-facing copy includes the licence.
SVG geometry is unchanged; engine-facing names and use groups live in the
generator. To check drift, run `bun scripts/fallback-icons.ts --check`.
